Slope classes of Same and Different items

sds_slope_classes.Rd

Classes of SDS items that share one slope in a "2PLclass" model (see fit_task_models_multigroup()): the dimensions block, the same block, and three classes of match-block picks. A match item is named sds_<k>match_choice<j>_<m>m<n>n, the j-th pick of a k-pick trial after m new matches and n new non-matches (see recode_sds()). Its class is:

  • match_first: the trial's first pick;

  • match_after_nonmatch: a later pick with an earlier non-match in the trial;

  • match_later: any other later pick (earlier repeats, which count as neither match nor non-match, don't change its class).

Usage

sds_slope_classes(item_uids)

Arguments

item_uids

character vector of item UIDs

Value

character vector of slope classes, one per item; an item that isn't an SDS item of a known block gets its UID, i.e. its own slope

Details

These classes were chosen in the 2026-11 recalibration (levante-pilots 03_summaries/calibration/sds_slopes.R): of 112 partitions of the match items by pick position, earlier errors, set size and earlier matches, they fit best by BIC in each half of the data and on the earlier data. First picks and picks after a non-match discriminate about half as well as other later picks.

Examples

sds_slope_classes(c("sds_dimensions_color", "sds_same_shape",
                    "sds_2match_choice1_0m0n", "sds_3match_choice3_1m1n",
                    "sds_3match_choice3_1m0n"))
#> [1] "dimensions"           "same"                 "match_first"         
#> [4] "match_after_nonmatch" "match_later"
